heading: Related programs
lead: An activity administered under the authority of the Secretary of Health and Human Services, that is operated for the same purpose as a program eligible to be carried out under this division, is encouraged to use services available under this division.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 12545 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 103–82, § 101(a).

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 101–610, title I, § 199E, formerly § 125, Nov. 16, 1990, 104 Stat. 3144; renumbered § 199E, Pub. L. 103–82, title I, § 101(a), Sept. 21, 1993, 107 Stat. 788.)
